arm_safety_checker_status: WORKS -- constructed successfully end to end with the downloaded files

arm_safety_checker_invocation.code:
from yam.kinematics import YamKinematics
from yam.voxel_map import VoxelMap
from yam.environment import ArmSafetyChecker

kin = YamKinematics(urdf_path='hwresearch/i2rt/robot_models/arm/yam_pro/v1/yam_pro.urdf')
vmap = VoxelMap.from_bounds([-1,-1,-1], [1,1,1], resolution=0.05)
checker = ArmSafetyChecker(kin, vmap, 'hwresearch/i2rt/robot_models/arm/yam_pro/v1/yam_pro.xml')
checker.is_free([0.0]*6)  # -> True
checker.clearance([0.0]*6)  # -> inf (empty voxel map, home pose)
arm_safety_checker_invocation.notes: kin.link_geometry loaded for base, gripper, link1-5, tip_left, tip_right -- matches MOVING_LINKS in yam/environment.py exactly. No mujoco build issues on this machine (arm64 macOS, py3.12) despite yam/kinematics.py's docstring caveat that 'mujoco's build chain does not install cleanly here' -- that may be stale or refer to a different machine/build path; a plain `uv pip install mujoco` pulled a prebuilt wheel with zero build step. Constructor also ran self-collision calibration (1200 samples default) without error at import/construct time.

gesture_ideas.name: wave
gesture_ideas.source: adapted from i2rt examples/minimum_gello + record_replay_trajectory patterns (joint-space keyframe interpolation, no IK needed)
gesture_ideas.joint_space_sketch: Hold j1,j2,j3,j4 near a raised 'arm up' pose (e.g. j2~1.2, j3~1.0, j4~0.3 rad) and oscillate only joint6 (wrist rotate, range +-2.0944 rad) between about -0.6 and +0.6 rad at ~1-2 Hz for 3-4 cycles, using yam.arm.YamArm.move_to for the raise and a simple sinusoidal command_positions loop for the oscillation. Cheapest gesture: only 1 joint moves at speed, everything else stays in a safety-checked static pose.

gesture_ideas.name: point
gesture_ideas.source: adapted from record_replay_trajectory.py's teach-then-replay pattern and solve_ik_collision_free in yam/kinematics.py
gesture_ideas.joint_space_sketch: Use solve_ik_collision_free(kinematics, target_xyz, checker, lower, upper) to solve a joint pose whose tip/probe axis aims at a target point (e.g. extend j3 to ~0.6-0.9, j4 near 0 to keep the forearm straight, j5/j6 near 0 for no wrist twist), then move_to that pose and hold. Verify with checker.segment_is_free(start, goal) before executing, per plan_and_run.py's existing pattern.

gesture_ideas.name: nod / acknowledge (pick-adjacent gesture)
gesture_ideas.source: inspired by bimanual_lead_follower.py's smooth small-amplitude joint moves used for handoff cues
gesture_ideas.joint_space_sketch: Small-amplitude oscillation on joint3 (shoulder lift, range [0, pi]) of about +-0.15 rad around a resting bent pose, 2 cycles at ~0.5 Hz -- reads as a 'nod' of the whole forearm rather than a wrist gesture. Keep gripper closed/neutral. Good low-risk demo motion since it stays mid-range on the joint with the largest self-collision-free envelope per yam/arm.py's own comment ('joint3 is the joint that actually lifts, and is self-collision-free across its whole range from home').
